title: AlphaSense Adds 10,000+ Investment Banking Users in Q3; Cites 300,000+ Expert Transcripts
summary: AlphaSense said an additional six of the world's 10 largest investment banks selected it as their AI platform in the most recent quarter, adding over 10,000 new investment banking users in Q3 and growing investment banking ARR 75% year-over-year. The company says it now serves 18 of the world's 20 leading investment banks among 100+ investment banks and 8,000+ enterprise customers. Bankers draw on research from 1,500+ providers and 300,000+ expert interview transcripts, and AlphaSense says AI agents now perform 99% of research activity on the platform.
whyItMatters: The release puts AlphaSense's expert transcript library at 300,000+ — well above the 100,000–130,000 figures cited by Third Bridge and Guidepoint — and shows that content being consumed predominantly by agents rather than human searches.
